t: The previous classification of the Devil Canyon-Bear Canyon Primitive Area is hereby abolished.

fable.w: The section only abolishes a prior land classification for the Devil Canyon-Bear Canyon Primitive Area. A possible tempting reading is that reclassifying public land implies public input, but the text provides for no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision here.

qwen_block.w: This section simply abolishes a land classification. It does not mention any consultation, public comment, advisory board, or coordination with outside parties (such as states, tribes, or the public) before or during this decision. It is a unilateral administrative action by the federal government.
